rewards.redemption_notes: Membership Rewards points can be used for travel, gift cards, statement credits, and more.

benefits.title: Pay Over Time Feature
benefits.description: The Pay Over Time feature lets you carry a balance with interest on eligible charges, up to your Pay Over Time Limit. Eligible charges will be automatically added to a Pay Over Time balance.

benefits.title: No Preset Spending Limit
benefits.description: The spending limit is flexible. Unlike a traditional card with a set limit, the amount you can spend adapts based on factors such as your purchase, payment, and credit history.

notes: Verified from official product page. Page does not display annual fee, APR, or welcome offer in static HTML. Only earn rates and basic benefits (Pay Over Time, No Preset Spending Limit) are visible.
